subject: Re: Request for extra evaluation credits for cross-team pilots
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@synthlab.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for extra evaluation credits for cross-team pilots

Hi Alex,

Appreciate you taking the time last week. We have three additional engineering teams that want to run short pilots in parallel (NLP research, recommendation, and a small product-play sandbox). Can you grant an extra 250k eval credits so each squad can run a 2-week spike? Procurement will route any paperwork after we validate results.

Attaching a list of the teams + PIs.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of AI Platforms | SynthLab
samira.khan@synthlab.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachments: synthlab_project_roster.csv (csv)

---
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@synthlab.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for extra evaluation credits for cross-team pilots

Samira —

Thanks for the roster. Before we can approve that scale of credits I need a bit more context so we can keep this aligned with our promo policy:
- Are these teams new accounts or existing seats under the same org?
- Is the 250k number total or per-team?
- Is there an active HubSpot deal / PO in flight? If not, who will sign on conversion?

We sometimes see coordinated requests across squads that are actually multiple distinct accounts trying to stack trial credits. If you can reply with a quick confirmation I’ll loop in our Ops team.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales Associate | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

---
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@synthlab.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for extra evaluation credits for cross-team pilots

Hi Alex —

Thanks. These are three distinct internal teams under the same SynthLab corporate account (we use subdomains for projects but billing is centralized). The 250k is total (split roughly 80/80/90). We don’t have a PO yet — procurement wants to see signal from the pilots before committing. Happy to introduce procurement if that helps.

Samira

---
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira.khan@synthlab.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request for extra evaluation credits for cross-team pilots — urgent verification

Team — forwarding a request from SynthLab. Looks legitimate on the surface but note: they asked for an unusually large shared grant with no PO. Marissa, this looks like an account expansion opportunity but I want Ops/fraud eyes before committing any promotional credits.

Attachments forwarded: synthlab_project_roster.csv, credit_request_form.pdf

Alex

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@synthlab.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for extra evaluation credits for cross-team pilots
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

(see above)

---
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request for extra evaluation credits for cross-team pilots — urgent verification

Alex/Ben/Marissa —

Quick fraud ops summary after reviewing the roster and historical logs:
- Org: SynthLab (hubspot org id 123456) has a single parent account but we see 6 distinct signups tied to similar email patterns over the last 10 months (team+number@synthlab.com).
- Two of the signups are flagged historically for previous trial-topup requests; one had a previous temporary credit grant that was followed by immediate account churn.
- Payment/billing address shows three different billing names attached to the org (odd for a centralized procurement flow).
- Attachment synthlab_project_roster.csv looks plausible; however, the requesting contact (samira.khan@synthlab.com) uses a different recovery phone number than prior legal contacts.

Recommendation: do not approve a blanket 250k promo grant immediately. Offer a limited, one-time allocation of 60k credits tied to an eval contract and require procurement introduction/PO within 21 days. If procurement does not engage we pull excess credits and recommend conversion to a paid pilot. We can also provision a sandbox environment with throttled rate limits to reduce cost risk.

If you want, I can take this and own the verification gate — I’ll request the procurement contact and cross-check billing names.

Neha Kapoor
Risk & Fraud Operations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

---
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@synthlab.com>, procurement <procurement@synthlab.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for extra evaluation credits for cross-team pilots

Samira —

Thanks for the quick follow-ups. Our Ops team reviewed and recommended a conservative path: we can approve a one-time 60,000 evaluation credit grant (to be split across the three teams) conditioned on:
1) Procurement introduction (procurement@synthlab.com) and an intent-to-purchase PO within 21 days;
2) Agreement to run pilots in the sandbox environment we’ll provision (rate-limited);
3) Redwood will monitor usage and reclaim any credits if linked accounts exhibit rapid churn or cross-account stacking.

If you accept, I will raise the grant and send a short confirmation document. If procurement prefers a larger grant, we can accelerate with a signed pilot SOW and a minimum commitment.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales Associate | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@synthlab.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for extra evaluation credits for cross-team pilots

Alex —

Understood. Procurement will loop in a PO contact by EOD and the teams are OK with a sandbox. Appreciate the compromise — looking forward to the confirmation doc.

Samira

Attachments referenced in thread: synthlab_project_roster.csv, credit_request_form.pdf
